'''Hōju Inari Shrine''' (宝珠稲荷神社, Hōju Inari Jinja) is a [[Shinto shrine]] in [[Japan]].

* [[Hōju Inari Shrine (Taitō, Tokyo)]] - Located in [[Taitō Ward]], [[Tokyo]], in the [[Kiyokawa]] district.
* [[Hōju Inari Shrine]] - Located in [[:en:Chūō Ward|Chūō Ward]], Tokyo, in the [[Ginza]] district.
* [[Fuchi Shrine|Hōju Inari Shrine (Nagasaki)]] - Located in [[:en:Nagasaki City|Nagasaki City]], [[Nagasaki Prefecture]], as a subordinate shrine of [[Fuchi Shrines]].
